value.rationale: This is a natural optimal edge-identification problem on the classical Pappus incidence graph, not a routine rephrasing of its known vertex metric dimension. The full classification reveals that edge and vertex metric minima are both four yet have 540 versus 216 bases, including 324 minimum edge-only configurations, together with five symmetry classes and a complete size polynomial. These are precise structural invariants suitable as a benchmark for biaffine-plane graph identification.
